description_en: Queries the triggers of a function
description_zh: 查询指定函数的触发器列表
kebab_example: aliyun fc-open list-triggers --service-name demo-service --function-name demo-function --limit 20 --next-token f-trigger --prefix a --start-key a-trigger --x-fc-account-id 1880770869020000 --x-fc-date Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT --x-fc-trace-id my-test-trace-id --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTriggers

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of resources to return. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100. The number of returned resources is less than or equal to the specified number
parameters.help_zh: 限定此次返回资源的数量。如果不设定，默认返回20，最大不能超过100。返回结果可能小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The token required to obtain more results. You do not need to provide this parameter in the first call. The tokens for subsequent queries are obtained from the returned results
parameters.help_zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，后续查询的token从返回结果中获取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The prefix that the names of returned resources must contain
parameters.help_zh: 限定返回的资源名称必须以prefix作为前缀
parameters.name: prefix

parameters.help_en: The returned resources are sorted in alphabetical order, and the resources that include and follow the resource specified by the startKey parameter are returned
parameters.help_zh: 设定结果从startKey之后（包括startKey）按字母排序的第一个开始返回
parameters.name: start_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: x_fc_account_id

parameters.help_en: The time when the request is initiated on the client. The format of the value is: EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.help_zh: 客户端发起请求的时间。格式为EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.name: x_fc_date

schema.description_zh: 查询触发器的返回结构体

nextToken.description_en: The token used to obtain more results. If this parameter is left empty, all the results are returned
nextToken.description_zh: 用来返回更多的查询结果。如果这个值没有返回，则说明没有更多结果
nextToken.title_zh: 用来返回更多的查询结果。如果这个值没有返回，则说明没有更多结果

createdTime.description_en: The time when the trigger was created

domainName.description_en: The domain name used to invoke the function by using HTTP. You can add this domain name as the prefix to the endpoint of Function Compute. This way, you can invoke the function that corresponds to the trigger by using HTTP. Example: `{domainName}.cn-shanghai.fc.aliyuncs.com`
domainName.description_zh: 域名名称，使用域名名称拼接上函数计算域名，可以采用HTTP协议调用到触发器对应版本的函数。例如`{domainName}.cn-shanghai.fc.aliyuncs.com`
domainName.title_zh: 域名名称，使用域名名称拼接上函数计算域名，可以采用HTTP协议调用到触发器对应版本的函数。例如{domainName}.cn-shanghai.fc.aliyuncs.com

invocationRole.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the RAM role that is used by the event source to invoke the function
invocationRole.description_zh: 事件源调用函数使用的RAM角色的ARN
invocationRole.title_zh: 调用函数使用的RAM角色的ARN

lastModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the trigger was last modified
lastModifiedTime.description_zh: 触发器的上次修改时间

qualifier.description_en: The version or alias of the service

sourceArn.description_en: The ARN of the event source

triggerConfig.description_en:
The configurations of the trigger. The configurations vary based on the trigger type. For more information about the format, see the following topics:

Object Storage Service (OSS) trigger: [OSSTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415697.html）.
Simple Log Service trigger: [LogTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415694.html）.
Time trigger: [TimeTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415712.html）.
HTTP trigger: [HTTPTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415685.html）.
Tablestore trigger: Specify the SourceArn parameter and leave this parameter empty.
Alibaba Cloud CDN event trigger: [CDNEventsTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73333.html）.
MNS topic trigger: [MnsTopicTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415695.html）.
EventBridge triggers: [EventBridgeTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/333711.html）
triggerConfig.description_zh:
触发器配置，针对不同类型的触发器，配置有所不同。具体格式请参考如下对应的数据结构：

OSS触发器：请参见[OSSTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415697.html）。
日志服务触发器：请参见[LogTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415694.html）。
定时触发器：请参见[TimeTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415712.html）。
HTTP触发器：请参见[HTTPTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415685.html）。
Tablestore触发器：只需要填写完整的SourceArn参数便可, 这里无需额外配置，取值为空{}。
CDN事件触发器：请参见[CDNEventsTriggerConfig](~~struct:CDNEventsTriggerConfig~~)。
MNS主题触发器：请参见[MnsTopicTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415695.html）。
EventBridge触发器：请参见[EventBridgeTriggerConfig](~~struct:EventBridgeTriggerConfig~~)

triggerId.description_en: The unique ID of the trigger

triggerType.description_en: The trigger type. Valid values: oss, log, tablestore, timer, http, cdn_events, mns_topic, and eventbridge
triggerType.title_zh: trigger类型，如 oss, log, tablestore, timer, http, cdn_events, mns_topic

urlInternet.description_zh: 公网域名地址。在互联网可以通过HTTP协议或者HTTPS协议访问HTTP Trigger
urlInternet.title_zh: 公网域名地址。在互联网可以通过HTTP协议或者HTTPS协议访问HTTP Trigger。

urlIntranet.description_en: The private endpoint. In a VPC, you can access HTTP triggers by using HTTP or HTTPS
urlIntranet.description_zh: 私网域名地址。在VPC可以通过HTTP协议或者HTTPS协议访问HTTP Trigger
urlIntranet.title_zh: 私网域名地址。在VPC可以通过HTTP协议或者HTTPS协议访问HTTP Trigger。
